One coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market. you

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as a superior cryptocurrency with worldwide mining adoption and claims it will become one of the most successful currencies, while directing viewers to OneCoin-USA.com and a subsequent video. The promotional presentation uses Bitcoin's past growth and broad success claims to encourage participation in the promoted token, rather than providing neutral market analysis or a warning.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 fits because the video markets a specific cryptocurrency and links it to superiority, future market success, and broad adoption. The supplied content does not show a purchase transaction or a completed financial loss, but it does provide a promotional participation pathway and appreciation-oriented claims about the token.
